naming_conventions: Use exact names for people and external systems as defined in the context level
Container names reflect their functional platform or gateway role
Portals and user-facing containers are named '<User Group>/<Target> Portal' or '<Target> Workstation'
Engines and infrastructural components use descriptive functional roles like 'Integration & Routing Engine'
